description: This file implements HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol, a class for managing file commit operations in Spark using Hadoop's OutputCommitter API, supporting job and task setup, commit, and abort procedures with handling for absolute and partitioned output paths.

classes.name: HadoopMapReduceCommitProtocol
classes.description: A class implementing FileCommitProtocol for Spark, managing job and task commit/abort with Hadoop OutputCommitter, supporting dynamic partition overwrite and absolute path handling.

methods.name: setupCommitter
methods.description: Initializes the OutputCommitter instance based on the output format class.

methods.name: newTaskTempFile
methods.description: Generates a temporary filename for a task, considering staging directory and optional subdirectory.

methods.name: newTaskTempFileAbsPath
methods.description: Generates a temporary absolute path filename for a task, tracking it for later move operations.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Constructs a filename based on task attempt ID, job ID, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: setupJob
methods.description: Sets up job IDs and configuration, and initializes the committer.

methods.name: commitJob
methods.description: Finalizes the job by moving files from staging to final locations, handling overwrites if necessary.

methods.name: abortJob
methods.description: Handles job abort, cleaning up staging directories and logging warnings on exceptions.

methods.name: setupTask
methods.description: Prepares the task context and initializes tracking structures.

methods.name: commitTask
methods.description: Commits a task, returning a TaskCommitMessage with tracked file moves.

methods.name: abortTask
methods.description: Handles task abort, cleaning up temporary files and logging warnings.
